item.title: reality is patient
item.description:
临溪流以静对，访草木以素心。登高极目知天地之大，置己苍茫知寸身之微。

当欲望得不到满足便痛苦，当欲望得到满足便无聊，人生就像钟摆一样在痛苦与无聊之间摆荡。– 叔本华

杜甫 《登高》

风急天高猿啸哀，渚清沙白鸟飞回。
无边落木萧萧下，不尽长江滚滚来。
万里悲秋常作客，百年多病独登台。
艰难苦恨繁霜鬓，潦倒新停浊酒杯。

“We must always take sides. Neutrality helps the oppressor, never the victim. Silence encourages the tormentor, never the tormented. Sometimes we must interfere.” – Elie Wiesel

the only thing new in the world is the history you do not know. – Harry S. Truman

Yes, you have come from an unhappy place. But listen. … If you leave your place of suffering with hatred in your heart, and anger against men, you will be deserving of our pity; but if you leave with goodwill, in gentleness and peace, you will have risen above any of us. – Victor Hugo
